title: Fall of the Roman Republic
summary: The Roman Republic gave way to one-man rule after a century of civil conflict.

key_concepts.explanation: An informal alliance of three powerful men.
The public listing of enemies who could be killed and their property seized.

outline.heading: Causes of instability
points: Generals relied on loyal armies rather than the state.

outline.heading: The end of the republic
points: Caesar crossed the Rubicon in 49 BC.
Augustus held power after the civil wars.

questions: Was the republic doomed or did individuals decide its fate?
references: the lecture reader on the late republic
